summary_en: The study tests STP938 (also called dencatistat), a CTPS1 inhibitor, in adults with advanced solid tumors. A safety expansion is also planned for advanced CTPS2 null ovarian cancer. STP938 is given by mouth as a single agent at up to 5 dose levels, and the duration and frequency of dosing are not stated. The official title says the study is Phase 1 and aims to evaluate safety, tolerability and pharmacokinetics.
summary_es: El estudio evalúa STP938 (también llamado dencatistat), un inhibidor de CTPS1, en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados. También se planea una expansión de seguridad en cáncer de ovario avanzado con CTPS2 nulo. STP938 se administra por vía oral como único medicamento, en hasta 5 niveles de dosis, y la duración y la frecuencia de la dosis no se indican. El título oficial indica que el estudio es de Fase 1 y busca evaluar la seguridad, la tolerabilidad y la farmacocinética.
who_for: Adults aged 18 or older with advanced disease that cannot be cured by available therapies and needs systemic therapy
ECOG performance status of 2 or lower
Life expectancy over 3 months, per the investigator; tumor tissue available for biomarker testing
not_for: Pregnant or breastfeeding women, or women of childbearing potential or men unwilling to use contraception
Known active or symptomatic brain metastases, carcinomatous meningitis, leptomeningeal disease, or prior spinal cord compression
Active malignancy within 2 years of enrollment
Known active or chronic hepatitis B or active hepatitis C infection
